subject.title: feat: agent_settled extension event for true session idle

question: Should OpenClaw expose `agent_settled` as a permanent plugin SDK lifecycle event with the proposed idle-versus-handoff semantics?
rationale: The patch introduces a new public extension API rather than a private refactor; tests can establish behavior but cannot decide whether this is the intended long-term plugin contract.

options.title: Accept the lifecycle contract
options.body: Approve the event as the supported once-per-quiescent-session signal and merge after ordinary final review.

options.title: Narrow or redesign the API
options.body: Specify a different lifecycle boundary or payload before adding a public event so extensions do not depend on ambiguous settlement semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept the lifecycle contract
recommendation.body: Approve the event as the supported once-per-quiescent-session signal and merge after ordinary final review.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies this person as the only visible owner of the proposed API and its stated semantics.
